detail.longDescription: WooCommerce still doesn't include abandoned cart recovery out of the box. Woo Cart Recovery is a lightweight fix: it captures the checkout email (classic and block checkout), sends two timed reminder emails with a one-click cart restore link, and shows how much revenue it recovered. It also adds a notice at checkout telling shoppers they may get a reminder. https:// gapfill-plugins.vercel.app/api /s?mastodon-woo-cart-recovery # WordPress # WooCommerce # WebDev
